title: Characteristics of anticancer activity of CBP/p300 inhibitors - Features of their classes, intracellular targets and future perspectives of their application in cancer treatment.
one_liner_zh: 该文综述CBP/p300抑制剂在癌症治疗中的类别、靶点与应用前景，不涉及蛋白质-DNA互作建模或AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Due to the contribution of highly homologous acetyltransferases CBP and p300 to transcription elevation of oncogenes and other cancer promoting factors, these enzymes emerge as possible epigenetic targets of anticancer therapy. Extensive efforts in search for small molecule inhibitors led to development of compounds targeting histone acetyltransferase catalytic domain or chromatin-interacting bromodomain of CBP/p300, as well as dual BET and CBP/p300 inhibitors. The promising anticancer efficacy in in vitro and mice models led CCS1477 and NEO2734 to clinical trials. However, none of the described inhibitors is perfectly specific to CBP/p300 since they share similarity of a key functional domains with other enzymes, which are critically associated with cancer progression and their antagonists demonstrate remarkable clinical efficacy in cancer therapy. Therefore, we revise the possible and clinically relevant off-targets of CBP/p300 inhibitors that can be blocked simultaneously with CBP/p300 thereby improving the anticancer potential of CBP/p300 inhibitors and pharmacokinetic predicting data such as absorption, distribution, metabolism, excretion (ADME) and toxicity.
abstract_zh: 由于高度同源的乙酰转移酶CBP和p300对癌基因及其他促癌因子转录升高的贡献，这些酶成为抗癌治疗中潜在的表观遗传靶点。广泛寻找小分子抑制剂的研究促成了针对CBP/p300的组蛋白乙酰转移酶催化域或染色质相互作用溴结构域（bromodomain）的化合物开发，以及双重BET和CBP/p300抑制剂的研发。在体外和小鼠模型中展现出的良好抗癌效果使CCS1477和NEO2734进入了临床试验。然而，所描述的抑制剂中无一能完全特异于CBP/p300，因为它们与其他关键功能域相似的酶共享相似性，这些酶与癌症进展密切相关，且其拮抗剂在癌症治疗中显示出显著的临床疗效。因此，我们重新审视CBP/p300抑制剂可能且临床相关的脱靶效应，这些靶点可与CBP/p300同时被阻断，从而增强CBP/p300抑制剂的抗癌潜力，并改善药代动力学预测数据，如吸收、分布、代谢、排泄（ADME）和毒性。
